product_metadata.title: Bravario Unbreakable Tritan Plastic Whiskey Glasses | Shatterproof Double Rocks | Dishwasher-Safe | BPA-free | Perfect for Cocktail Bourbon | 12.5 oz, Set of 4
features: UNBREAKABLE & INDESTRUCTIBLE: Protect your guests and home with Bravario's stylish, shatterproof plastic whiskey glasses. Serve all your favorite cocktails without worrying about broken glass around your pool, hot tub or damage to prized glassware.

IMPACT-RESISTANT: Tritan plastic cocktail glasses can withstand drops without splitting or breaking. Lightweight and seamless, Bravario Rocks Lowball Glasses boast all the sophistication of real glass without the risk of injury.

12.5-OZ CAPACITY: These shatterproof old-fashioned glasses are perfect for drinking bourbon, scotch, cognac and whiskey straight-up or on the rocks. Classic round styling and smooth rims ensure a comfortable grip and easy sipping.

NON-TOXIC, DISHWASHER-SAFE: Stronger than regular acrylic glassware that can scratch or become cloudy, our 100% Tritan plastic glasses retain their clear & glass-like clarity. Drink with peace of mind knowing your glasses are BPA- and phthalate-free.

HANDSOMELY BOXED, GREAT FOR GIFTS: Bravario Whiskey Tumbler sets are a must-have addition to any kitchen or home bar. Great gift for weddings, housewarmings, birthdays, Father’s Day, anniversaries, and more!
